package arbposted

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"github.com/certen/independant-validator/pkg/finality/strictbrotli"
)

// Oracle of test/fixtures/finality/strictbrotli_double_fault1 (certen-sdk). Run inside pkg/finality/arbposted of the validator at cbb6373:
//   FP_DF_DIR=<dir with *.br and cases_in.json> go test ./pkg/finality/arbposted -run TestFixPostedDoubleFault -count=1
// It reads cases_in.json ([{id, stream, cap}]) and writes cases_go.json: for each case Go's answer of strictbrotli.Decompress(stream, cap) and of
// decodePayload(0x00 || stream, cap, 1<<20), the Arbitrum batch decode that names the refusal.
type dfIn struct {
	ID     string `json:"id"`
	Stream string `json:"stream"`
	Cap    int    `json:"cap"`
}

type dfGo struct {
	Kind  string `json:"kind"`
	Bytes int    `json:"bytes,omitempty"`
}

type dfPayload struct {
	Status               string `json:"status"`
	ExceededUncompressed bool   `json:"exceeded_uncompressed"`
}

type dfOut struct {
	ID           string    `json:"id"`
	Stream       string    `json:"stream"`
	Cap          int       `json:"cap"`
	Strictbrotli dfGo      `json:"strictbrotli"`
	Payload      dfPayload `json:"payload"`
}

func dfStatusName(s payloadStatus) string {
	switch s {
	case payloadOK:
		return "ok"
	case payloadOffL1:
		return "off_l1"
	case payloadUnknownHeader:
		return "unknown_header"
	case payloadUndecodable:
		return "undecodable"
	case payloadTooLarge:
		return "too_large"
	}
	return "status_" + strconv.Itoa(int(s))
}

func TestFixPostedDoubleFault(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("FP_DF_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Fatal("FP_DF_DIR is required")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "cases_in.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var in []dfIn
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &in); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var out []dfOut
	for _, c := range in {
		s, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, c.Stream+".br"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		o := dfOut{ID: c.ID, Stream: c.Stream, Cap: c.Cap}
		b, exceeded, err := strictbrotli.Decompress(s, c.Cap)
		switch {
		case exceeded:
			o.Strictbrotli = dfGo{Kind: "exceeded"}
		case errors.Is(err, strictbrotli.ErrEmpty):
			o.Strictbrotli = dfGo{Kind: "empty"}
		case errors.Is(err, strictbrotli.ErrIncomplete):
			o.Strictbrotli = dfGo{Kind: "incomplete"}
		case errors.Is(err, strictbrotli.ErrTrailing):
			o.Strictbrotli = dfGo{Kind: "trailing"}
		case err != nil:
			o.Strictbrotli = dfGo{Kind: "decode"}
		default:
			o.Strictbrotli = dfGo{Kind: "ok", Bytes: len(b)}
		}
		res := decodePayload(append([]byte{0}, s...), c.Cap, 1<<20)
		o.Payload = dfPayload{Status: dfStatusName(res.status), ExceededUncompressed: res.exceededUncompressed}
		out = append(out, o)
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "cases_go.json"), append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
